verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents a public API (api.lorikeetcx.ai) with structured auth-error responses and its own API reference page, plus a hosted OAuth-secured MCP server (mcp.lorikeetcx.ai) confirmed live via runtime probes, giving AI-native users a documented programmatic surface to drive workflows, diagnostics, and simulations. Missing for 10: independent/third-party developer confirmation of API usage beyond Lorikeet's own docs and probes.
